Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionExplore a city of Gothic architecture torn between past and future in Desolus, a first person puzzle game. An enigmatic cataclysm has fractured reality, opening portals which lead to other times. Explore the past and future versions of an expansive city. Solve Escher-like puzzles through the use of black holes, traveling back and forth through time to make architecture whole again. Challenge your spatial thinking by navigating impossible architecture, as reality distorts and time becomes increasingly unstable. Activate holograms to move massive portals between floors of crumbled cathedrals, allowing you to traverse structures which only partially exist in one time. Partner with the city's guardian to prevent a cataclysm which threatens to merge past and future. Save the City of Desolus from annihilation.Show morePublished byThe Quantum Astrophysicists GuildDeveloped byMark J. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionStep back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans. Play Toy Story (1995), Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue! (1999), Toy Story 2 (1999), Buzz Lightyear of Star Command (2000), Toy Story Racer (2001) and A Bug’s Life (1998). Includes 11 total versions of the games across console and handheld. The games have been enhanced with quality-of-life improvements, including Rewind, Rex’s Cheat Codes, and more. Use Rewind to retry mistakes when you miss a jump across Andy’s shelves or take too many hits from the angry, wind-up robot. Unlock game-specific enhancements like unlimited lives or invincibility with Rex’s Cheat Codes. Step inside Digital Eclipse’s behind-the-scenes experience, featuring exclusive interviews withJason Katz – Head of Story, Pixar, Jim Hanks – Voice Actor, Luigi Priore – VP and GM, Disney & Pixar Games, and Jon Burton – Founder, TT Games, who helped bring these adventures to life. Explore a richly-detailed virtual museum filled with rare design documents, vintage development photos, and archival content. Listen to your favorite songs from the games in the Music Player, where we’ve rounded up the soundtracks from every game in the collection. FEATURES - Play five classic games, including four Toy Story games and A Bug’s Life. Includes 11 total versions of the games across console and handheld. - Enhancements and quality-of-life improvements make the games easier to learn and understand for gamers of all ages. - Use Rewind to fix your mistakes. Messed up a jump? Took too many hits? Simply hold a button and scrub back to before you made that mistake and try again. - Includes a behind-the-scenes experience featuring new interviews with Jason Katz – Head of Story, Pixar, Jim Hanks – Voice Actor, Luigi Priore – VP and GM, Disney & Pixar Games, and Jon Burton – Founder, TT Games. - Explore the virtual museum filled with rare design documents, vintage development photos, and archival content. - Use Rex’s Cheat Codes!
